title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. BAKUNDUKIZE
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. BAKUNDUKIZE
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA 00075/2025/CA (Ndahayo, P.J.)
28 Mutarama 2026]
Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha – Ugushidikanya – Ugushidikanya
kugomba kurengera ushinjwa hakwemezwa ko ari umwere ku cyaha akurikiranweho.
Amategeko agenga imiburanishirize y’imanza z’inshinjabyaha – Ugushidikanya – Kugira ngo
Umucamanza afate icyemezo gihamya icyaha, agomba kuba afite ibimenyetso bihamya nta
gushidikanya (preuves à conviction au-delà de tout doute raisonnable) ko ushinjwa ariwe wakoze
icyaha, Umucamanza agomba gusesengurana ubushishozi uruhurirane rw’ibimenyetso,
agahamya ushinjwa icyaha mu gihe gusa asanga nta wundi mwanzuro wagerwaho n’isesengura
yakoze uretse iryo gusanisha uwakoze icyaha n’icyaha cyakozwe.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Uwitwa Bakundukize yakurikiranyweho icyaha cyo gusambanya ku gahato
umukecuru uri mu cyigero cy’imyaka 71 witwa Muhutukazi Ancille, nyuma y’iperereza
Ubushinjacyaha bumuregera Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo busaba ko ahamwa n’icyaha.
Urwo Rukiko rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko uregwa ahamwa n’icyaha, rumuhanisha igifungo cya
burundu.
Uregwa yajuririye mu Rukiko Rukuru avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha kandi nta bimenyetso
bigaragaza ko yagikoze, asaba ko hemezwa ko ari umwere.
Urwo Rukiko rwaciye urubanza rwemeza ko Uregwa akomeza guhamwa n’icyaha, rumuhanisha
igifungo cy’imyaka 20.
Bakundukize yajuririye mu Rukiko rw’Ubujurire asaba ko hemezwa ko icyaha aregwa atagikoze,
agasobanura ko nta kimenyetso na kimwe kimushinja icyaha kuko nta muntu wamufashe arimo
gukora icyo cyaha.
Ku rundi ruhande Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko ibimenyetso byashingiweho n’Urukiko mu guhamya
icyaha Bakundukize bifite ishingiro kuko uwakorewe icyaha yabyemeje kandi ubuhamya bwe ngo
bwagombaga guhabwa ishingiro kuko nta kibuza ko imvugo z’uwakorewe icyaha zashingirwaho
mu guhamya icyaha uregwa, ndetse na raporo ya muganga yashingiweho ikaba ari ikimenyetso
kimushinja kuko yagaragaje ko uwo mukecuru Muhutukazi Ancile yasambanyijwe.
Incamake y’icyemezo: 1. Ugushidikanya kugomba kurengera ushinjwa hakwemezwa ko ari
umwere ku cyaha akurikiranweho.
2. Kugira ngo Umucamanza afate icyemezo gihamya icyaha, agomba kuba afite ibimenyetso
bihamya nta gushidikanya (preuves à conviction au-delà de tout doute raisonnable) ko ushinjwa
ariwe wakoze icyaha, Umucamanza agomba gusesengurana ubushishozi uruhurirane
rw’ibimenyetso, agahamya ushinjwa icyaha mu gihe gusa asanga nta wundi mwanzuro wagerwaho
n’isesengura yakoze uretse iryo gusanisha uwakoze icyaha n’icyaha cyakozwe.
Ubujurire bufite ishingiro.

Urubanza rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru rurahindutse.
Nta mategeko yashingiweho
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPA 0084/10/CS; Ubushinjacyaha vs Gatera1 rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga ku wa 09/05/2014;
RPAA 00318/2020/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs Birasa Jean Claude rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire
kuwa ku wa 29/11/2024;
RPAA 00434/2023/CA - CMB RPAA 00353/2023/CA - CMB RPAA 00366/2023/CA - CMB
00435/2023/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs Mazina Déogratias alias Gasongo n’abandi rwaciwe
ku wa 29/11/2024,
RPAA 00737/2021/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs UWAYISABA HABIMANA Antoine rwaciwe ku wa
16/12/2022;
RPAA 00249/2023/CA; Ubushinjacyaha vs BAZIMAZIKI Gratien rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/12/2024.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] kuwa 23/11/2020 ari mu mudugudu wa Kirehe, Akagari ka Nyaburiba, Umurenge wa Jali,
Akarere ka Gasabo, Umujyi wa Kigali, habonetse amakuru avuga ko hari umukecuru ufite imyaka
71 wakoreshejwe imibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato, uwaketswe ko yakoze icyo cyaha akaba ari
Bakundukize Fils.
[2] Inzego zibishinzwe zakoze iperereza, rirangiye ubushinjacyaha bumurega icyaha cyo
gukoresha undi imibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato, mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo maze
mu mu rubanza RP 01565/2020/TGI/GSBO urwo Rukiko rwemeza ko Bakundukize Fils ahamwa
n’icyaha, rumuhanisha igihano k’igifungo cya burundu.
[3] Bakundukize Fils yajuririye Urukiko Rukuru, avuga ko yahamijwe icyaha kandi nta
bimenyetso bigaragaza ko yagikoze, asaba ko hemezwa ko ari umwere.
[4] Mu rubanza RPA 01237/2021/HC/KIG rwaciwe ku wa 10/01/2025 Urukiko Rukuru
rwemeje ko Bakundukize Fils ahamwa n’icyaha aregwa, rumuhanisha igihano k’igifungo kingana
n’imyaka 20. Mu gufata icyo cyemezo Urukiko rwasobanuye ko rusanga Bakundukize Fils
yihunza icyaha kandi yaragikoze kuko aterekana icyatuma umukecuru w’imyaka mirongo irindwi
irenga amubeshyera icyaha nk’icyo cyane ko uwo mukecuru anasobanura uko yagiye ahohoterwa
n’uwo mwana we kandi ko bitari bibaye ubwa mbere, kandi na raporo ya muganga ikaba
ishimangira ko umukecuru yasambanyijwe.
[5] Bakundukize Fils yongeye kujuririra Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, urubanza ruhabwa RPAA
00075/2025/CA ruburanishwa ku wa 09/01/2026, Bakundukize Fils yunganiwe na Me Kananga

Protegene, Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Mbaragijimana Desire, Umushinjacyaha ku rwego
rw’igihugu.
[6] Mu mwanzuro utanga ubujurire wa Bakundukize Fils n’umwunganizi we asaba ko
hemezwa ko icyaha aregwa atagikoze, agasobanura ko nta kimenyetso na kimwe kimushinja
icyaha kuko nta muntu wamufashe arimo gukora icyo cyaha.
[7] Uhagarariye ubushinjacyaha avuga ko ibimenyetso byashingiweho n’Urukiko mu
guhamya icyaha Bakundukize Fils bifite ishingiro kuko uwakorewe icyaha yabyemeje kandi
ubuhamya bwe ngo bwagombaga guhabwa ishingiro kuko nta kibuza ko imvugo z’uwakorewe
icyaha zihabwa zashingirwaho mu guhamya icyaha uregwa, ndetse na raporo ya muganga
yashingiweho ikaba ari ikimenyetso kimushinja kuko yagaragaje ko uwo mukecuru Muhutukazi
Ancile yasambanyijwe.
[8] Ikibazo kigomba gusuzumwa muri uru rubanza ni ukumenya niba ibimenyetso
byashingiweho n’Urukiko Rukuru mu kwemeza ko Bakundukize Fils yakoresheje ku gahato
imibonano mpuzabitsina nyina bihagije.
II. ISESENGURA RY’IKIBAZO KIGIZE URUBANZA
[9] Bakundukize Fils n’umwunganira bavuga ko mu kumuhamya icyaha, Urukiko Rukuru
rwashingiye ku mvugo za nyina kandi zitaragombaga gushingirwaho kuko yagiye yivuguruza aho
avuga ko amatariki yasambanyirijweho ya 23/11/2020 ataraye mu rugo kuko yatinyaga ko
amusambanya, nyamara ukibaza ukuntu yamusambanyije ataharaye. Bakomeza bavuga ko
kimenyetso cyashingiweho kigizwe n’ubuhamya bwatanzwe n’uwitwa Habumugisha Theoneste
butagombaga guhabwa agaciro kuko butera gushindikanya, kuko yavuze ibyo atiboneye n’amaso
ye, ahubwo ari ari ibyo yabwiwe n’uwakorewe icyaha, izi mvugo ze rero zikaba zitaragombaga
guhabwa ishingiro kuko ari ibihuha uyu Habumugisha Theoneste yahimbye kuko bafitanye
amakimbirane ashingiye ku mitungo kuko ari nyirarume.
[10] Basobanura ko kandi ubuhamya bwa Muhutukazi Ancile butagombaga gushingirwaho
kuko agenda yivuguruza mu gusobanura ibyamubayeho nk’uko ubugenzacyaha bwabigaragaje
aho mu ibaruwa yo ku wa 23/11/2020, Ubugenzacyaha bwandikiye umuhanga ukorera ISANGE
Kacyiru, bumusaba gukorera Muhutukazi Ancille isuzuma, muri iyo baruwa, Umugenzacyaha
akaba yaratanze inshamake y’uko ibintu byagenze, asobanura ko bamuzaniye Muhutukazi Ancille
abamuzanye bakavuga ko bacyeka ko yasambanyijwe n’umuhungu we, ariko ko Muhutukazi
Ancille adashobora gusobanura neza ibyamubayeho, ko abazwa akabyemera ariko yakongera
kubazwa akabihakana. Basobanura rero ngo ibyo bigaragaza ko ibyo Muhutukazi Ancille yavuze
byose bijyanye n’isambanywa rye bidakwiye gufatwaho ukuri kuko afatwa nk’umuntu udashobora
kuba umutangabuhamya, dore ko Urukiko rwagaragarijwe ko asanzwe agira ikibazo cy’uburwayi
bwo mu mutwe.
[11] Banavuga kandi ko hatigeze habaho gupima ADN ngo bigaragare ko hari aho Bakundukize
yaba ahuriye no gusambanywa kwa Muhutukazi Ancille nk’uko ubushinjacyaha bubimurega.
[12] Uhagarariye ubushinjacyaha avuga ko harebwe raporo ya muganga n’imvugo
z’abatangabuhamya, ari ibimenyetso bihagije bishinja icyaha Bakundukize Fils, naho kuba

hatarapimwe ADN bitatesha agaciro ibindi bimenyetso byashingiweho kuko atari cyo kimenyetso
cyonyine kigomba gushingirwaho. Naho kuba nyina yaragiye yivuguruza ubushinjacyaha buvuga
ko koko byabayeho ariko bikaba bitatesha agaciro imvugo ze kuko busanga byaraterwaga
n’ikibazo yaterwaga n’ipfunwe ryo kuba havugwa ko yasambanyijwe n’umwana we, akaba
yaratinyaga kubivuga, ko ariko Urukiko rwabisuzuma.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA
[13] Impaka ziri muri uru rubanza zishingiye ku kumenya niba Bakundukize Fils yarahamijwe
icyaha cyo gusambanya umubyeyi we nta bimenyetso bidashidikanywaho bikimushinja.
[14] Ku bijyanye n’ibishingirwaho ngo hemezwe ko uregwa ahamwa n’icyaha byasobanuwe
n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire mu manza zitandukanye harimo urubanza RPAA 00737/2021/CA, no mu
zindi manza zaciwe nyuma yarwo harimo urubanza RPAA 00249/2023/CA na RPAA
00949/2024/CA1, muri izo manza Urukiko rukaba rwaremeje ko: “kugira ngo Umucamanza afate
icyemezo gihamya icyaha, agomba kuba afite ibimenyetso bihamya nta gushidikanya (preuves à
conviction au-delà de tout doute raisonnable) ko ushinjwa ariwe wakoze icyaha, ko Umucamanza
agomba gusesengurana ubushishozi uruhurirane rw’ibimenyetso, agahamya ushinjwa icyaha mu
gihe gusa asanga nta wundi mwanzuro wagerwaho n’isesengura yakoze uretse iryo gusanisha
uwakoze icyaha n’icyaha cyakozwe”.
[15] Nk’uko kandi byasobanuwe mu rubanza RPA 0084/10/CS rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ikirenga
ku wa 09/05/2014 haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Gatera1, ugushidikanya kugomba kurengera
ushinjwa hakwemezwa ko ari umwere ku cyaha akurikiranweho. Uwo murongo wanakurikijwe
mu zindi manza zaciwe n’uru Rukiko, hmu ziheruka gucibwa harimo nk’urubanza RPAA
00318/2020/CA haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Birasa Jean Claude (igika cya 33) n’urubanza RPAA
00434/2023/CA - CMB RPAA 00353/2023/CA - CMB RPAA 00366/2023/CA - CMB
00435/2023/CA haburana Mazina Déogratias alias Gasongo n’abandi (igika cya 36), zombi zaciwe
ku wa 29/11/2024.
[16] Nk’uko bigaragara mu rubanza rwajuririwe, kugira ngo Urukiko Rukuru rwemeze ko
Bakundukize Fils ahamwa n’icyaha cyo gusambanya umubyeyi we nk’uko yagihamijwe
n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo, rwabishingiye ku kuba ataravuguruje ibimenyetso
byashingiweho n’urwo Rukiko Rwisumbuye bigizwe n’imvugo z’umubyeyi we Muhutukazi
Ancile umushinja ko yamusambanyije, imvugo z’umutangabuhamya Habumugisha Theogene
wasobanuye ko Muhutukazi Ancile yamuganirije ko Bakundukize Fils ajya amusambanya ndetse
na raporo ya muganga igaragaza ko mu gitsina cya Muhutukazi Ancile hatukuraga.
[17] Ku birebana n’ikimenyetso cya raporo ya muganga igaragaza ko mw’isuzuma ry’umubiri
muganga yasanze ku gitsina cya Muhutukazi Ancile hatukura, hari n’ibikomere (vaginal
lacerations) akaba nta ndwara zandurira mu mibonano mpuzabitsina zagaragaye.
1 Reba Urubanza Nº RPAA 00737/2021/CA rwaciwe ku wa 16/12/2022, haburana Ubushinjacyaha
na UWAYISABA HABIMANA Antoine igika cya 16-17 n’Urubanza Nº RPAA 00249/2023/CA,
rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 20/12/2024, haburana BAZIMAZIKI Gratien (igika cya 15).

[18] Urukiko rurasanga iyo urebye iyo raporo ya muganga, mu bisobanuro byatanzwe, ntaho
muganga yigeze avuga ko ibimenyetso yasanze mu gitsina cya Muhutukazi Ancile byatewe no
gusambanywa nkuko Urukiko Rukuru rwabisobanuye, ahubwo muganga we yasobanuye
ibimenyetso yasanzemo ariko ntiyagaragaza icyabiteye, bityo iyo raporo ikaba itafatwa
nk’ikimenyetso cyashingirwaho mu kwemeza ko Bakundukize Fils yamusambanyije.
[19] Kubijyanye n’ibindi bimenyetso byashingiweho n’Urukiko Rukuru bigizwe n’imvugo za
Muhutukazi Ancile, Urukiko Rukuru rwasanze rwazishingiraho rubisobanura ruvuga ko
umubyeyi atabeshyera umwana we ndetse ko atabeshya ikintu nk’icyo kandi ari umubyeyi ukuze,
ndetse runasobanura ko imvugo ze zishimangirwa n’imvugo z’umutangabuhamya Habumugisha
Theoneste wasobanuye ko uyu Muhutukazi Ancile yamuganirije ko Bakumdukize Ancile ajya
amusambanya ndetse ko yamusambanyije ku wa 23/11/2020 abantu bagahurura agahita amuvaho.
[20] Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ariko rurasanga izo mvugo ze zitera gushidikanya kuko yemeza ko
yakoreshejwe imibonano mpuzabitsina ku gahato ariko akaba nta kindi kimenyetso cyagaragajwe
cyunganira izo mvugo ze cyatuma hemezwa ko ibyo yavuze ari ukuri ndetse n’imvugo
z’umutangabuhamya washingiweho nawe akaba avuga ko ibyo yavuze yabibwiwe na Muhutukazi
Ancille, akaba atavuga ibyo yiboneye n’amaso ye.
[21] Ku bijyanye n’ibyashingiweho n’Urukiko Rukuru ruvuga ko umubyeyi adashobora
kubeshyera umwana we ko yakoze icyaha nk’icyo Bakundikize Fils aregwa kandi ngo ari
umubyeyi ukuze, Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga iryo atari ihame ryemejwe ku buryo
ryashingirwaho mu guca imanza kuko ntacyacyaherwaho mu kwemeza ko ibyo bidashoboka.
[22] Ku bijyanye n’ibyavuzwe n’umutangabuhamya ko hari abantu basanze Bakundukize Fils
arimo gusambanya nyina, agasobanura mu bugenzacyaha ko abo bantu bagombaga kuza gutanga
ubuhamya ndetse n’umugenzacyaha mu gusoza iperereza akaba yaravuze ko hazabazwa
abatangabuhamya, Urukiko rurasanga abo batangabuhamya batarigeze babazwa ngo
hamenyekane uko ibyo bikorwa byaba byaragenze ngo bishimangire ibyavuzwe na Muhutukazi
Ancille.
[23] Nk’uko rero bimaze gusobanurwa haruguru, Urukiko rw’Ubujurire rurasanga ibimenyetso
byashingiweho mu guhamya icyaha Bakundukize Fils birimo ugushidikanya ku kumenya niba
icyaha aregwa yaragikoze, uko gushidikanya kukaba kugomba gushingirwamo mu kwemeza ko
atsinze hashingiwe ku mirongo yatanzwe mu manza zagaragajwe haruguru.
ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwa Bakundukize Fils bufite ishingiro;
[24] Rwemeje ko urubanza RPA 01237/2021/HC/KIG, rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru ku wa
10/01/2025 ruhindutse;
[25] Rwemeje ko Bakundukize Fils adahamwa n’icyaha aregwa cyo gukoresha undi imibonano
mpuzabitsina kugahato
[26] Rutegetse ko Bakundukize Fils ahita afungurwa uru rubanza rukimara gusomwa.

[27] Rutegetse ko amagarama y’urubanza aherera ku Isanduku ya Leta.
